proposal.reason: Main change is CI execution behavior: `.github/workflows/source-sanity.yml`, `pccl-daily-full.yml`, and `build-artifactory-ppu.yml` now resolve `t-head/pccl-tests` by matching branch with fallback to `main`, propagate the resolved SHA through jobs, and in build-artifactory add authenticated `docker/login-action` before image pull to avoid unauthenticated pull failures. This is test/workflow run selection, checkout, cache-key/revision plumbing, and job execution control owned by **ci**. Supporting edits in `.github/xtest/artifact_cache.py` and `test_workflow_contract.py` only realign CI fixture/revision contract checks to that runtime-resolution model, not contribution/review policy (workflow).
